_comment: panelkit design tokens for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8 V2 (#208).
Every number here was measured on the glass during #205 -- nothing is invented.
One file, two readers: uikit/tokens.py (generators) and tools/simulator/lint.js
(the pre-flash check). Neither redefines a number; change it here or nowhere.

device.note: portrait; the launcher owns the top-edge home gesture

text.note: 11px shipped in #205 and was unreadable -- 16 is a hard floor, not a suggestion. At 368x448 at arm's length, desktop sizing runs about half of what works. The floor moved 15 -> 16 because 15 is not on font_ladder and was therefore being drawn at 12.
text.font_ladder_note: The ONLY font sizes that exist on this board. CONFIG_LV_USE_FREETYPE and CONFIG_LV_USE_TINY_TTF are both off in examples/system/super/sdkconfig, so the TTFs under /system/fonts are never loaded and every glyph comes from a compiled-in LVGL Montserrat. get_builtin_font() in gui/brookesia_gui_lvgl/src/style_font.cpp returns an exact match or else the closest SMALLER face -- a size off this ladder does not scale, it silently rounds DOWN. That is how the shell's 11sp clock ended up drawn at 8px and how a 56px 'hero' is really 48px. Snap every size to a rung.
text.line_height_note: Real .line_height from each lv_font_montserrat_<n>.c, not a guess. A label box shorter than this clips descenders. Ratio is ~1.1x the nominal size -- eyeballing it as 1.3x (a desktop CSS habit) falsely condemns boxes that are fine and hides the ones that are not.

touch.note: 50-56px tall buttons 10px apart read as one blob and caused mis-taps. In-game controls are full-height thirds -- target the outcome, not the control.

color.note: Cloudera orange + the leaderboard medal set, taken from the racing game's own leaderboard.html

note: Trap 1: layout.type flex on a parent silently overrides its children's absolute x/y -- a screen renders near-blank.
Trap 2: requireValidPress drops a tap the finger drifted through, and container defaults to scrollable:true, so a small drag becomes a scroll.

safe_area.note: The glass is a ROUNDED rectangle, so the usable width near the top and bottom edges is narrower than 368 -- text placed at the nominal 16px edge inset but only a few pixels down is inside the corner arc and reads as jammed into the curve (or is physically cut). Required inset at vertical distance d from the edge is R - sqrt(R^2 - (R-d)^2). At d=2 with R=52 that is 39px, which is why x-viewer's 'n/N' counter at x=16,y=2 kept coming back as 'too close to the corner'.
safe_area.calibration: corner_radius is an ESTIMATE. It is not in any board yaml, datasheet or driver in this tree -- nothing on the device reports it. 52 is deliberately on the generous side: over-inset costs a few pixels, under-inset is a visible defect and this is the second round on it. To calibrate properly, change this ONE number and regenerate -- everything downstream (lint R10, panelkit.corner_inset) reads it from here.
